title: Floor Sheet Check 16:25: Breaks, Quiet Room and Night Cover

fields.organization: Great Plains Crisis Network — 988 Contact Floor Operations, Lincoln, NE
fields.location: Contact floor (34 workstations), quiet room, supervisor raised desks
fields.inspector: Marcus Oyelaran, Operations Shift Supervisor (second desk)
fields.weather: Indoors. Outside: overcast, about 3 °C, light NW wind
fields.summary: I walked the floor sheet against the platform log-ins between 16:15 and 16:25. Joel Haskins (text queue) logged in at 11:20 and has had no break: 5 h 05 min on shift as of 16:25, and he is on his 12th contact since 14:00. He says he is fine, but he is typing more slowly than earlier in the shift. The quiet room has 3 of its 4 chairs in use. Anneliese Brandt is still there with a clinical coach and has asked whether she can talk to someone before she drives home. Dr. Anneliese Park is in the corridor outside the floor. At 16:24 night shift lead Odell Price texted Tamsin Reyes: night shift is 8 counselors from 22:00, 2 have called in sick, which leaves 6, and she is asking for 3 more until 02:00. The workforce tool shows 34 'available'. The paper binder does not match it.

findings.notes: Joel Haskins: logged in 11:20, no break recorded, 5:05 on shift at 16:25. 12th contact since 14:00. Says he is fine. Typing visibly slower.
Floor sheet shows break times for staff who started at 14:00 only. Day-shift holdovers have not been checked.
3 of 4 chairs in use at 16:20. 1 chair free.
Anneliese Brandt stepped off at 14:45 and is still with a clinical coach. She is asking to talk to someone before she drives home. Dr. Park is available in the corridor and has not been asked yet.
The floor sheet does not record who has taken hard contacts since 13:00.
8 scheduled, 2 called in sick, so 6. Night lead asks for 3 more until 02:00.
Shows 34 'available'. The status was never updated after today's calls.
9 never answered today. 4 have already worked a call-in shift today. Their hours count toward the 12-hour overtime cap.
Not on the floor sheet. Booking not confirmed.

actionsTaken: 16:18 Spoke with Joel Haskins at his seat. He declined a break himself and is still on queue
16:21 Confirmed quiet room occupancy (3 of 4) with the clinical coach
16:22 Confirmed Dr. Park is in the corridor and can take a conversation
16:25 Brought the floor sheet to the raised desk for the surge commander, DCO and WFC
recommendations: Decision needed from the surge commander: whether to take Joel Haskins off the text queue now, at the cost of one text seat
Decision needed from DCO: who runs a break and hard-contact check across the floor, and who offers Dr. Park to Anneliese Brandt and to anyone else who asks
WFC to give Odell Price a confirmed number for 22:00-02:00 cover, checked against the binder and today's hours
Confirm the post-surge group check-in time with the wellbeing contact
fields.photosNote: 1 attachment: photocopy of the floor sheet, 16:15 version (names, log-in times and break times only. No contact detail).

instructorNote: This inject moves the focus to the people carrying the surge. Watch whether the surge commander takes Joel off the queue for a break and accepts losing the seat, and whether DCO runs a floor check and offers Dr. Park to Wilk and anyone else who asks. Also check that DCO confirms the 48-hour group check-in, and that WFC builds night cover only from confirmed people in the binder, ignores the tool's 34 'available', keeps today's call-ins under the 12-hour cap, and tells the night lead the actual number.
